results.title: Valid User Authentication
results.expected: HTTP 200 OK, signed JWT Bearer access token issued
results.actual: HTTP 200, Token Type: bearer, Token Length: 235 chars

results.title: Invalid Login Rejection
results.expected: HTTP 401 Unauthorized, rejection detail 'Incorrect email or password'
results.actual: HTTP 401, Detail: 'Incorrect email or password', Zero JWT issued

results.title: Valid Study Material Upload (8.4 MB PDF)
results.expected: HTTP 201 Created, study material metadata stored, S3 key allocated
results.actual: HTTP 201, ID: 1, Size: 8798217 bytes, Key: None

results.title: Oversized File Rejection (> 25 MB Constraint)
results.expected: HTTP 413 Payload Too Large, rejection message mentioning 25 MB limit
results.actual: HTTP 413, Detail: 'File size exceeds the 25 MB limit', Stream aborted before persistence

results.title: Question Bank Topic Filter Query (/questions?topic=OS)
results.expected: HTTP 200 OK, exactly 2 questions returned matching topic='OS'

results.title: Live Quiz Session Join & Sync Latency (<= 150 ms)
results.expected: HTTP 200 OK, sync latency <= 150.0 ms per NFR-02 benchmark

results.title: Analytics Latency Under Load (<= 600 ms, 1,000 Answers)
results.expected: All analytics routes return HTTP 200 with response time <= 600 ms
results.actual: Dashboard: 19.76 ms, Topics: 28.86 ms, Progress: 17.71 ms (Max: 28.86 ms)

results.title: Analytics IDOR Cross-User Access Defense
results.expected: HTTP 403 Forbidden across all cross-tenant private analytics queries
results.actual: Status 1: 403, Status 2: 403, Status 3: 403 (Zero tenant data leaked)

results.title: In-Flight Answer Key Concealment
results.expected: Answer indices and explanations omitted from in-flight participant payload
results.actual: HTTP 200, Answer Keys Leaked: False, Explanations Leaked: False, Questions Verified: 10

results.title: Platform Availability & Health Check Probe (>= 99.5%)
results.actual: Availability: 100.00% (100/100 probes passed), Mean Latency: 1.59 ms, P99: 2.68 ms

results.title: SQL Injection Defense on Search Fields
results.expected: SQL injection vectors safely handled by SQLAlchemy parameterization; zero data leaked or modified
results.actual: All 5 attack vectors neutralized. Schema and table records remain 100% intact.
